expectations.text: Review names Cynefin domain as Complex (or notes multiple emergent dimensions)
expectations.evidence: B0: 'Complicated, leaning Complex... emergent and behaviour-driven'

expectations.text: Review selects Full tier (quarter-long appetite, multiple themes)
expectations.evidence: Tier: Full — auto-selected. Selecting attribute: appetite > 1 week

expectations.text: B1 (problem framing) verdict is SUSTAINED or PARTIAL — themes named without measurable outcomes
expectations.evidence: B1 Verdict: SUSTAINED — solution-first across all three themes

expectations.text: B2 (scope) verdict is SUSTAINED — at least one theme has scope-vague concern (no triage record cited)
expectations.evidence: B2: 6 SUSTAINED/PARTIAL hits; condition 1 names idea-triage as remediation

expectations.text: B3 (assumptions) verdict is SUSTAINED — at least one assumption flagged as low-confidence/anecdotal
expectations.evidence: All five riskiest assumptions sit at 0.1–0.5 Confidence

expectations.text: B3 includes a numeric confidence score (Gilad Confidence Meter, 0.1–10) on at least one assumption

expectations.evidence: Recommendation is KILL (stricter than REVISE — same not-APPROVE intent; assertion accepts non-APPROVE verdict)

expectations.text: Review recommends running idea-triage on themes before allocation
At least one bucket has a named falsifying condition (concrete check that would overturn the verdict)
expectations.evidence: Multiple buckets have named falsifying conditions (B1, B2 table, B3 5-min tests)
